title.narrative: Framework Partnership between the EU and the Global Consortium for Death Penalty Abolition - Action 1

description.narrative: Contract related to: Framework Partnership between the EU and the Global Consortium for Death Penalty Abolition - Action 1 - Through strategic work in partnership with civil society organisations (CSOs), the Action aims at advancing human rights issues that require a global approach and/or are too sensitive to be managed through single-country projects. The Action will address in particular human dignity (fight against the death penalty, torture and ill-treatment), and discrimination on the basis of most sensitive issues such as gender identity, sexual orientation, sex characteristics, religion or belief.

title.narrative: 1.1 Number of international and regional commitments on the abolition, ratification, transparency, and reduced use of the death penalty, of strategic States for the abolitionist movement, as a result of the intervention (disaggregated by type of commitment)

This indicator will consider abolitionist engagements made with the participation of newly engaged stakeholders of the abolitionist ecosystem among the following : Youth sector; Womens and LGBTQIA rights sector;Disability right sector ; Cultural and artistic sector ;Religious sector ; Private entrepreneurship sector ;Directly impacted people : people on death row, their families, exonerees, executioners, prisons wardens opposed to the death penalty, etc.
